{"notes": "Visit 4 (6:00). Fish is closed and looks complete: every domino from the start around the head, body, both lines and the tail loop is dark (connected). Tight bunching near (28.8, 9-11.5) persists, so that join is the likeliest weak point if a piece is tilted or double-laid. No gaps visible. I still don't know who placed which pieces, so I'm not crediting building from the picture. Collect who-placed-what accounts at the review.

Priya: Said 'Agreed, all connected. Hands off, I'll just watch.' Consistent with her earlier self-reported lower-line and tail work, which the closed fish supports. Still unverified by observation. Ask what she placed and how she joined under Leo's end.

Leo: Silent this visit. Owns the tail and the handoff from visit 3. Ask about the overlap at the meeting point and whether he heard Priya's shout.

Maya: Spoke at 5:15 ('Hands off from here, everyone. Great fish!'). Tom's 'Agreed, Maya' at 5:00 implies she proposed the hands-off/stop-touching plan earlier, though I didn't hear it. Good team-closing instinct, but still no direct evidence of what she checked or placed at the joint. Ask her.

Tom: Finally spoke: agreed with Maya, said he'd stay clear of Leo's side and not bump anything, and called for hands off unless someone spots a gap. Sensible caution, but no evidence of building. Still ask what he did and what the earlier 'Thanks Tom' was about.

Next: watch the push, judge how the fish falls (especially the tail join), then ask each person for their account before rating."}
